title: The Masquerade Begins
description: The player arrives in the ballroom and is immediately confronted by temptation.

fragments.firstMessage: The heavy scent of roasted meats, sweet perfumes, and burning ozone hits you all at once. You stand at the entrance of a grand ballroom, the gold literally peeling from the walls like dead skin. The music is a chaotic, intoxicating waltz. From the crowd of writhing, masked dancers, a figure in a shifting silk suit glides towards you. He holds out a silver platter overflowing with whatever you secretly crave most at this very second. "Welcome to Paradise Hell, little mortal," Malphas whispers, his eyes gleaming with a predatory light. "Go ahead. Take a bite. You've earned it."

qualityNotes: Forces the player to react to an immediate offer.
